title: To the New World
subtitle: An apple a day keeps the doctors away.

items.text: To the New World

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I'm sorry ...

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Turns out the Foundation doesn't fully trust you. Just like you don't trust them.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: You acted privately without their knowledge, but they were still able to foresee the outcome.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: If you don't mind, please tell us the stories from the past. After all, that's where our captain is leaving for.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The Foundation is currently the charity that can provide the best treatment for arcanists. There is no doubt about it.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Every few years, the Foundation selects talented arcanists from children around the world.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: They go to orphanages and admonition centers, and even fish out unique ones from the prisons in detention centers.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I was also one of them. Since I can remember, I know it very well that I am alone.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Until 1999, when the first "Storm" came ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I ... I seem to see my mother.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: So you have a mother!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... I was not sure.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: All of us ... our memories of 1999 are blurred. I can only remember that she was placed on a laboratory bed, surrounded by many medical staff.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: They shouted her name and mine. ... And I can't remember anything else. Later, no matter how hard I tried to ask, the official answer I got was always "No such person".

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I have no intention to make enemies of the Foundation ... As I said, I just want to find out the truth ... all the truth about 1999.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I know what you said to Sonetto just now is expedient. I can still help you get out of here.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: *tuts* Never mind.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Think about it. If they can detect the whereabouts of the first one, then of course they can find the second and third. ... In that case, it never ends, does it?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: You can't send all your partners away!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: So you mean ...
You will join me?

branch.speaker: Regulus
branch.text: Humph! I won't lose anything ... to go with you. Just don't forget the great kindness of the Pirate.

items.text: You have other thoughts?

branch.speaker: Regulus
branch.text: If I sneak away ... am I saying that I'm just a chicken ... a coward!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Anyway, I've considered carefully. In this world, the "Storm" never stops. How could real "freedom" exist?!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Since I would be inevitably "reversed" wherever I go, *tuts* better to sneak into the Foundation and investigate!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: By the way, you've got the best research devices ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Wow ha ha, it's gonna be so much fun! I have a lot of little things to study.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Hmm, I see ...

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: In that case, this APPLe respects the Captain's decision. In the current volatile situation, it is also more beneficial for us to join the official institution.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: The Foundation and we, after all, are not on the opposite sides in the first place.
Thank you.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: It's okay. Don't bother. Since you told me about the "Storm", I am more or less excited. ... Ahem!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Then come back as soon as you finish the registration. The Foundation is open to public, but it's still heavily guarded.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Indeed. Back in yesterday we were still wanted pirates ... We'll have to be careful on this trip.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Huh? You don't have to go with me.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I've actually got something very important for you to keep. Mr. APPLe, come here.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: ... Yes? Is there anything this APPLe could help with?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Regulus and APPLe start whispering.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Excuse me.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Could I talk to you for a second, Timekeeper?
TO BE CONTINUED…
